text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, perfect.
Today I'll ask someone to run alongside—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Allllriiiight!! In top shape today!!
My blood is pumping!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Can anyone do a training run with me!?
I'll take on any challenger!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ! Um, if that's the case, then I—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Heh, guess I've got no choice but to go then.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, small fry like you should just step aside.
This is a job for me, the "Runaway Windmill of the Academy"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Whoa now. What are you holding back for, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Unless I'm mistaken, you looked raring to take on
Vodka's challenge. Did you lose your nerve
'cause she beat you to the punch?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Listen, Dober. No matter how full of confidence the others seem, none of that matters.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You wanting to be the first to step forward...
Basically, it just means you wanna go one-on-one
with Vodka, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ain't nothin' to it! Just focus on crushing the one you've got your eyes on and run!
Go on, get out there!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Alrighty then... Well,
mind if I join in too?
